principles: Paying only the minimum keeps the balance, and the interest, going for years.
Clear the card with the highest interest rate first.
If you cannot clear it, ask your card provider for help before you miss a payment.

gentle.title: Card interest is costing you
gentle.body: You were charged {card_interest_last_month} in card interest last month. Paying a little more than the minimum each month brings that down, and it is worth asking whether your provider offers a lower rate.

blunt.title: You paid {card_interest_last_month} in card interest
blunt.body: Card interest cost you {card_interest_last_month} last month and it will keep coming until the balance is cleared. Pay more than the minimum, starting with the card that charges most.
